question: A man covers half part of a certain distance at 15 km/hr. He covers 40 percent of remaining distance at the speed of 12 km/hr and covers rest of the distance at the speed of 21 km/hr. What is his average speed for the entire journey?
solution:
**Given:**

A man covers half part of a certain distance at 15 km/hr.

He covers 40 percent of remaining distance at the speed of 12 km/hr and covers rest of the distance at the speed of 21 km/hr. 

**Concept used:**

Average speed = Total Distance / Total time

**Calculation:**

Let the total distance is 420 km ( LCM of 12, 15 and 21)

Time taken to travel 1st 210 km is

⇒ 210 / 15 = 14 hr

Remaining distance 420 - 210 = 210

He travels 210 × 40 /100 = 84 km at 12 km/hr

Time taken to travel 84 km is,

⇒ 84 / 12 = 7 hr

Remaining distance 210 - 84 = 126 km

Time taken to travel km is,

⇒126 / 21 = 6 hr

Total time taken,

⇒ 14 + 6 + 7 = 27 km

Average speed is ,

⇒ 420 / 27 = 140 /9 km/hr

**∴ The correct option is 3**
